I’m not connected to a live weather feed, but I can give you a quick snapshot of what San Francisco typically feels like:

| Season | Typical Temperature | Common Weather Patterns |
|--------|---------------------|-------------------------|
| Winter (Dec–Feb) | 48–58 °F (9–14 °C) | Cool, often cloudy, occasional fog, light rain |
| Spring (Mar–May) | 55–65 °F (13–18 °C) | Mild, sunny days, some fog, light showers |
| Summer (Jun–Aug) | 60–75 °F (16–24 °C) | Warm, dry, frequent fog in the mornings, clear skies |
| Fall (Sep–Nov) | 55–70 °F (13–21 °C) | Pleasant, sunny, occasional rain, cooler evenings |

If you’re planning a trip or just curious about today’s conditions, you can check a reliable weather site (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the National Weather Service) or use a weather app on your phone. Let me know if you’d like a quick summary of the current forecast from a specific source!
